title: Lakeside Picnic Gathering, 1947 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot featuring a group of people enjoying an outdoor lakeside picnic on July 26, 1947. The subjects sit around a long wooden picnic table laden with food and dishes, framed by trees with a brightly lit body of water in the background. The hairstyles and striped clothing reflect post-World War II American casual style.
